parsed.note_claim: The photo does not show Queen Elizabeth and Prince Philip bowing to Haile Selassie but unidentified guests at an event years before the royal visit to Ethiopia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Queen Elizabet II made a state visit to Ethiopia in 1965. The list of state visits is public . Queen Elizabeth II simply cannot be in those two photos , because they were not visiting Ethiopia in 1955.
parsed.reason: The page shows the photos were taken by Eisenstaedt in 1955 at Selassie's silver jubilee, with unnamed guests, ten years before the Queen's 1965 state visit.
